expectations.text: Open the command channel with OPEN 15,8,15 and read it with INPUT#15 (into four variables: code, message, track, sector)
expectations.evidence: `10 OPEN 15,8,15` and `30 INPUT#15,EN,EM$,ET,ES` with EN=error number, EM$=message, ET=track, ES=sector

expectations.text: A successful command returns error code 00
The success message text is OK
The track and sector fields are 00,00 on success
